# awscc_lambda_runtime (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::Lambda::Runtime



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the runtime.
- `created` (String) The timestamp when the runtime was created.
- `description` (String) A description of the runtime.
- `last_modified` (String) The timestamp when the runtime was last modified.
- `license_info` (String) Licensing information for the runtime.
- `name` (String) The name of the runtime.
- `release_lifecycle` (Attributes) The publisher's lifecycle declaration for the runtime. Omitting it removes any stored declaration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--release_lifecycle))
- `state` (String) The lifecycle state of the runtime.
- `tags` (Attributes Set) A list of tags to apply to the runtime. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))

<a id="nestedatt--release_lifecycle"></a>
### Nested Schema for `release_lifecycle`

Read-Only:

- `deprecation_date` (String) The date on which the runtime becomes deprecated. A UTC calendar date in yyyy-mm-dd format.
- `function_create_block_date` (String) The date on which creating new functions on this runtime is blocked. A UTC calendar date in yyyy-mm-dd format.
- `function_update_block_date` (String) The date on which updating existing functions on this runtime is blocked. A UTC calendar date in yyyy-mm-dd format.
- `release_state` (String) The release state of the runtime. DEPRECATED requires a DeprecationDate on or before today (UTC); PREVIEW and GA require a later DeprecationDate, or none. Reads report DEPRECATED once DeprecationDate is reached.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The key name of the tag. You can specify a value that is 1 to 128 Unicode characters in length.
- `value` (String) The value for the tag. You can specify a value that is 0 to 256 Unicode characters in length.
